create_submission_file: create a NeurIPS 2021 Open Catalyst Challenge submission file from prediction results using the CLI script
write_is2re_relaxations_from_traj: write IS2RE relaxation predictions from trajectory .traj files into a compressed NPZ submission file
write_is2re_relaxations_hybrid: write IS2RE hybrid relaxation predictions from S2EF NPZ files using force and energy models
write_predictions: write S2EF or IS2RE predictions from an NPZ results file into a challenge submission NPZ file
run_submission_cli: run the CLI script with --path and --out-path args to generate a challenge submission file
